no_reentrancy_guard_present.meaning: addRewards and claimRewards are external functions that perform transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard

pending_accounting_increased.meaning: pending-reward accounting has already been increased in addRewards

transfer_from_completed.meaning: the external transferFrom call in addRewards has completed

reentrant_entrypoint_invoked.meaning: claimRewards or another entrypoint is invoked reentrantly while pending-reward accounting has been increased but transferFrom has not completed

griefing_occurs.meaning: griefing is enabled by the reentrancy window

assumptions: The external transferFrom call is the point at which a malicious token can re-enter.
Pending-reward accounting is increased before the external transferFrom call in addRewards.

unresolved.description: Report does not establish whether claimRewards authorization currently permits the reentrant call; the intent's forbidden invocation is encoded as an observable occurrence rather than a completed withdrawal.

limitations: The impact 'griefing' is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report provides no more specific observable outcome.
The safety relation is expressed as absence of a reentrant entrypoint invocation during the accounting-increased/transfer-not-completed window.

links.reported_relation: addRewards updates pending-reward accounting before external transferFrom, and a malicious token can re-enter during transferFrom while accounting is already increased, producing a reentrancy window used for griefing.
Attackers can force re-entry into claimRewards during addRewards, demonstrating an exploitable reentrancy window that enables griefing.
